decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is peripheral to the firm's announced waste-to-value direction and was only mentioned on the website, but it builds on an existing offer and needs little investment, so management will likely keep it and attribute weak early sales to market ramp-up.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions sit at the core of the firm's announced sustainable technology mission and build on its sunk engineering investment, so commitment to them stays strong.

The waste oil to energy plant has its own web page, a visible public commitment, and is central to the firm's direction, so management will persist and treat any slow uptake as a temporary deployment delay.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant fits the firm's flagship narrative of making previously uneconomic technologies viable, and the prototyping investment already made encourages management to continue despite uncertain early results.
